newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -6 Dec 22 week.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -6 Dec 22 week.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News consumer comfort index fell four points to -6.0 from -2.0 in the week ended December 22.

The survey, this time with 1,042 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
Respondents' confidence in the economy fell to -6.0 from -4.0 the previous week.
Confidence in personal finances decreased six points to 14 from 20, and Americans' rating of buying climate fell four points to -26.
Geographically, confidence fell in all regions, dipping farthest in the Midwest, to -7.0 from -2.0.
